description: This PHP source file defines a controller class for handling the password reset success page in the OrangeHRM authentication system. The class extends a base Vue controller and implements a public interface, setting up a view component to display a success message without a header.

classes.name: RequestPasswordSuccessController
classes.description: A controller class that renders a success page after a password reset, setting a Vue component and a template for the view.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Sets up the view for the password reset success page by initializing a Vue component and setting the template.
